directive.quote: Avery, 2026-11-03: every piece of every file of his gauntlet tree is a row with a check or a recorded reason, never one row per file and never a byte slice; all his checks are one tree in one list, one judge. Port one to one from old trillion.

old_copy.deleted_with: old trillion removes scripts/method-atoms.mjs and sweepAtoms (with scripts/method-sources.mjs --coverage and its tests in test/method-sources.test.mjs) and calls tool:split-a-document-into-pieces and tool:check-every-piece-is-covered; this session may not write to old trillion, so the PR names it as open

preserve: sweepAtoms: changed pieces with the checks citing them, gone pieces, uncovered pieces (new or not), orphan checks and reasons whose covered_by names a missing check
a piece is covered by a check citing it or by a recorded no_check reason
allowed_deltas: the header names its new home and shapes

coverage(pieces, checks) is the --coverage report of scripts/method-sources.mjs:150-160 over piece rows instead of a sources file: per file, pieces, with a check, with a reason, uncovered by name, and status failed when any is uncovered
coverageInRecords reads the piece rows and the checks they name through the records door, read only
banned_substitutions: a sources file on disk in place of the person's rows
a write to the person's records
a pass while any piece is uncovered
